finalText:
Build is green now (exit 0).

Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage:
- `src/core/options.js` — still read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now hands options as `{ retryCount }`, so it crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the strict boolean check only accepted `true`/`false` and threw otherwise. Now treats `undefined` as disabled (`false`), matching the old default behavior.

The remaining 8 warnings (Node `DEP0xxx` deprecations, `W1042` crypto.createCipher, `W2213` unused export, `W3307` circular import) are pre-existing lint/deprecation noise, not build-breaking — left as-is since fixing those wasn't the ask, but flagging `W1042` (`crypto.createCipher` deprecated, remove before v5) as worth a follow-up since it's a real API deprecation warning rather than just log noise.
